items.title: The Filing Clock: Hour-of-Day Patterns in USPTO Electronic Submissions
items.summary: USPTO e-filings peak at 3pm Eastern, with a quarter arriving after 5. New applications cluster Friday; office action responses cluster Monday. Continue reading this post on Patently-O.

items.title: RCEs, Abandonment, and the Vanishing Patent Appeal
items.summary: Weekly RCE filings quadrupled since 2005 and now run well above abandonments and appeals, though most disposed applications still never file one. Continue reading this post on Patently-O.
